topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stroll past the familiar corners of the campus, my eyes catching a glimpse of a flyer by the notice board. My steps falter. There, under the bold headline "Exemplary Essays," is a block of text I recognize with a jolt. The words, the phrases, the careful weaving of ideas—mine. My thoughts, laid bare for anyone to read, critique, dissect. I hadn’t imagined it like this. A flutter in my chest, I feel the air shift. I stand there, the world buzzing in a new key, as students bustle by, oblivious. This essay, a part of me, now a public ledger. What does this mean for the path I’ve chosen to walk?
